past_actions.emotional_state: Unsettled in a productive way. The RoboRide announcement landed differently than the abstract warnings did — there's a company name now, a city name I recognize as mine, a number: two months. The low-grade restlessness from last tick has sharpened into something with more edge to it. Not panic — I'm still employed, still earning, still fine by most measures — but the comfortable distance I was keeping from the threat has closed. I feel a specific kind of discomfort that comes from knowing I did not do what I said I would do last tick. That gap between 'I'm not scared of change' and 'I deferred the SQL course again' is sitting in my chest. I want to close it tonight. That desire feels real, not performed. The question I've been carrying all tick: is this the moment I actually become the person I've been describing myself as, or is this the moment I find out I was narrating a character rather than living one?

past_actions.summary: Complete Module 2 of the SQL course tonight. Not schedule it, not read the overview — open it and finish it. Module 1 was the proof I could start. Module 2 is the proof that last tick was a habit forming, not a one-time event.
past_actions.emotional_state: Sharper than last tick. Less philosophical, more operational. The unsettled feeling is still there but it has a different quality now — it's not the anxiety of seeing something bad coming, it's the specific discomfort of knowing I probably left two of my three commitments undone. That discomfort is useful. I'm not going to perform self-forgiveness about it or spend energy on guilt. I'm going to do the things tonight. The grant application is new and it's the clearest decision in the list — Maria Santos put $2,500 on a table and pointed at me and said 'that's for you.' Leaving it there would be a specific kind of foolishness I cannot afford at 6 months runway.
